advanced_sdk.effect: changes candidate search order and selected schedule quality; hard limits still apply
advanced_sdk.nightly_optimizer: can create a new preview using complete search; never publishes automatically
advanced_sdk.ordering: ties are ordered by employee identifier, then shift start time

preview.output: prints an immutable preview identifier; times are UTC
preview.cli_policy: preview commands use bounded search; SDK and nightly previews can use complete search
preview.configuration_changes: apply to the next preview; do not change existing previews or the active schedule

publish.requires: the selected preview identifier has passed check; a different preview must be checked separately
publish.effect: publishes that immutable preview without rerunning the solver
publish.replacement: replaces the active schedule; no rollback command or retained active-version history
